**Chosen Labeling:** [Lectin, Laminin, DAPI]
**Justification:** CUBIC (Clear, Unobstructed Brain/Body Imaging Cocktails and Computational Analysis) is selected for its high compatibility with whole-organ clearing (10 mm scale), excellent preservation of endogenous fluorescence, and aqueous-based processing which minimizes tissue shrinkage compared to organic solvents. This is critical for accurately quantifying glomerular volume changes. The labeling strategy uses Lectin to visualize the glomerular capillary loops and filtration barrier, Laminin to outline the glomerular basement membrane and Bowman's capsule for precise segmentation, and DAPI for nuclear localization to count total glomeruli and assess cellularity.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Rehydration
1.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) ethanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
1.2 Incubation with 25% (vol/vol) ethanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
1.3 Incubation with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

2 Permeabilization and Decolorization (CUBIC-L)
2.1 Incubation with CUBIC-L solution (25% (wt/vol) urea, 25% (wt/vol) N,N,N',N'-tetrakis(2-hydroxypropyl)ethylenediamine, 15% (wt/vol) Triton X-100 in dH2O). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 3 days)
2.2 Wash with PBS containing 0.1% (vol/vol) Tween-20 (PBST). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 day)

3 Immunolabeling
3.1 Incubation with blocking solution (5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum, 0.1% (vol/vol) Tween-20, 0.1% (wt/vol) sodium azide in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 day)
3.2 Incubation with primary antibody solution: Rabbit anti-Laminin (1:500) and Biotinylated Lycopersicon esculentum (Tomato) Lectin (1:200) in blocking solution. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)
3.3 Wash with PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 day)
3.4 Incubation with secondary reagent solution: Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated Streptavidin (1:500) and Alexa Fluor 594-conjugated Donkey anti-Rabbit IgG (1:500) in blocking solution. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days)
3.5 Wash with PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 day)

4 Nuclear Staining
4.1 Incubation with DAPI solution (1 µg/mL DAPI in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 days)
4.2 Wash with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 day)

5 Refractive Index Matching (CUBIC-R)
5.1 Incubation with CUBIC-R solution (45% (wt/vol) urea, 30% (wt/vol) sucrose, 10% (wt/vol) 2,2',2''-nitrilotriethanol in dH2O). **Chosen Method:** CUBIC
**Chosen Labeling:** [Lectin, Laminin, DAPI]
**Justification:** CUBIC (Clear, Unobstructed Brain/Body Imaging Cocktails and Computational Analysis) is selected for its high compatibility with whole-organ clearing (10 mm scale), excellent preservation of endogenous fluorescence, and aqueous-based processing which minimizes tissue shrinkage compared to organic solvents. This is critical for accurately quantifying glomerular volume changes. The labeling strategy uses Lectin to visualize the glomerular capillary loops and filtration barrier, Laminin to outline the glomerular basement membrane and Bowman's capsule for precise segmentation, and DAPI for nuclear localization to count total glomeruli and assess cellularity.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Rehydration
1.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) ethanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
1.2 Incubation with 25% (vol/vol) ethanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
1.3 Incubation with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

2 Permeabilization and Decolorization (CUBIC-L)
2.1 Incubation with CUBIC-L solution (25% (wt/vol) urea, 25% (wt/vol) N,N,N',N'-tetrakis(2-hydroxypropyl)ethylenediamine, 15% (wt/vol) Triton X-100 in dH2O). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 3 days)
2.2 Wash with PBS containing 0.1% (vol/vol) Tween-20 (PBST). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 day)

3 Immunolabeling
3.1 Incubation with blocking solution (5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum, 0.1% (vol/vol) Tween-20, 0.1% (wt/vol) sodium azide in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 day)
3.2 Incubation with primary antibody solution: Rabbit anti-Laminin (1:500) and Biotinylated Lycopersicon esculentum (Tomato) Lectin (1:200) in blocking solution. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)
3.3 Wash with PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 day)
3.4 Incubation with secondary reagent solution: Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated Streptavidin (1:500) and Alexa Fluor 594-conjugated Donkey anti-Rabbit IgG (1:500) in blocking solution. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days)
3.5 Wash with PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 day)

4 Nuclear Staining
4.1 Incubation with DAPI solution (1 µg/mL DAPI in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 days)
4.2 Wash with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 day)

5 Refractive Index Matching (CUBIC-R)
5.1 Incubation with CUBIC-R solution (45% (wt/vol) urea, 30% (wt/vol) sucrose, 10% (wt/vol) 2,2',2''-nitrilotriethanol in dH2O). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 days)

{"version":"exact-legacy-full-criterion-and-new-unique-query-batch-candidate-v2","schema_version":"full-criterion-subobligation-schema-v3-declared-procedure-parameters","protocol":"**Chosen Method:** CUBIC
**Chosen Labeling:** [DAPI, Phalloidin, Ki67+Alexa Fluor 647]
**Justification:** CUBIC is selected for its high compatibility with 3D organoids, excellent preservation of fluorescence signals (crucial for detecting Ki67 and Phalloidin), and rapid clearing capability suitable for high-throughput screening. The aqueous nature of CUBIC avoids the shrinkage associated with organic solvent-based methods, ensuring accurate volumetric measurements. The combination of DAPI (total nuclei), Phalloidin (structural outline), and Ki67 (proliferation) directly addresses the scientific goals of assessing growth, density, and drug effects.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Sample Preparation & Rehydration
1.1 Wash fixed organoids (4% PFA) with 1x PBS containing 0.1% Tween-20 (PBST) to remove residual fixative. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min)
1.2 Incubate with 0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS for permeabilization. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2 Immunolabeling & Staining
2.1 Block non-specific binding with Blocking Solution (3% Donkey Serum, 0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
2.2 Incubate with Primary Antibody against Ki67 (Rabbit anti-Ki67, 1:500) diluted in Antibody Diluent (1% Donkey Serum, 0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
2.3 Wash with PBST to remove unbound primary antibody. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours, change buffer every 30 min)
2.4 Incubate with Secondary Antibody (Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 647, 1:500), Phalloidin (e.g., Alexa Fluor 488 conjugate, 1:200), and DAPI (1 µg/mL) diluted in Antibody Diluent. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
2.5 Wash with PBST to remove unbound dyes and antibodies. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours, change buffer every 30 min)

3 Delipidation & Clearing (CUBIC-L)
3.1 Incubate with CUBIC-L solution (25% Urea, 25% N,N,N',N'-Tetrakis(2-hydroxypropyl)ethylenediamine, 15% Triton X-100 in H2O). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 6-12 hours, until transparent)

4 Refractive Index Matching (CUBIC-R)

payload.protocol:
**Chosen Method:** CUBIC
**Chosen Labeling:** [DAPI, Phalloidin, Ki67+Alexa Fluor 647]
**Justification:** CUBIC is selected for its high compatibility with 3D organoids, excellent preservation of fluorescence signals (crucial for detecting Ki67 and Phalloidin), and rapid clearing capability suitable for high-throughput screening. The aqueous nature of CUBIC avoids the shrinkage associated with organic solvent-based methods, ensuring accurate volumetric measurements. The combination of DAPI (total nuclei), Phalloidin (structural outline), and Ki67 (proliferation) directly addresses the scientific goals of assessing growth, density, and drug effects.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Sample Preparation & Rehydration
1.1 Wash fixed organoids (4% PFA) with 1x PBS containing 0.1% Tween-20 (PBST) to remove residual fixative. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min)
1.2 Incubate with 0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS for permeabilization. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2 Immunolabeling & Staining
2.1 Block non-specific binding with Blocking Solution (3% Donkey Serum, 0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
2.2 Incubate with Primary Antibody against Ki67 (Rabbit anti-Ki67, 1:500) diluted in Antibody Diluent (1% Donkey Serum, 0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
2.3 Wash with PBST to remove unbound primary antibody. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours, change buffer every 30 min)
2.4 Incubate with Secondary Antibody (Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 647, 1:500), Phalloidin (e.g., Alexa Fluor 488 conjugate, 1:200), and DAPI (1 µg/mL) diluted in Antibody Diluent. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
2.5 Wash with PBST to remove unbound dyes and antibodies. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours, change buffer every 30 min)

3 Delipidation & Clearing (CUBIC-L)
3.1 Incubate with CUBIC-L solution (25% Urea, 25% N,N,N',N'-Tetrakis(2-hydroxypropyl)ethylenediamine, 15% Triton X-100 in H2O). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 6-12 hours, until transparent)

4 Refractive Index Matching (CUBIC-R)
4.1 Incubate with CUBIC-R solution (45% Sucrose, 30% Urea, 10% 2,2',2''-nitrilotriethanol, 0.1% Triton X-100 in H2O). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
4.2 Transfer to fresh CUBIC-R solution for final RI matching and storage prior to imaging. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

{"version":"candidate-only-subobligation-support-consumer-v4-published-instance-criteria","schema_version":"full-criterion-subobligation-schema-v2-published-instance-parameters","protocol":"**Chosen Labeling:** [Brn3a+Alexa Fluor 488, Brn3b+Alexa Fluor 568, CD31+Alexa Fluor 647], EyeCi
**Chosen Method:** EyeCi
**Justification:** EyeCi is specifically optimized for the ocular structure, which contains high levels of melanin that cause significant light absorption and scattering. The protocol includes a hydrogen peroxide bleaching step in an organic solvent environment, which effectively removes intraocular pigment while preserving the structural integrity of the retina. By removing the cornea and lens, the reagents can better penetrate the Retinal Ganglion Cell (RGC) layer. The use of Alexa Fluor dyes combined with the high refractive index matching of Ethyl Cinnamate (ECi) ensures high-contrast imaging of both the delicate retinal vasculature (CD31) and the nuclear transcription factors (Brn3a/Brn3b) with minimal background interference.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 **Pre-treatment and Pigment Bleaching**
1.1 Dissection of the fixed eyeball in PBS to remove the cornea and lens to facilitate reagent penetration.(Temperature: RT, Time: 0.5 hours)
1.2 Dehydration in a graded ethanol series: 50%, 70%, and 100% (vol/vol) ethanol in distilled water.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per step)
1.3 Incubation in bleaching solution containing 3% H2O2 (vol/vol) in 100% ethanol to remove melanin.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 18 hours)
1.4 Rehydration in a graded ethanol series: 100%, 70%, and 50% (vol/vol) ethanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per step)

2 **Immunolabeling**
2.1 Permeabilization and blocking in PBS containing 0.5% Triton X-100 and 5% Normal Donkey Serum.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
2.2 Incubation with primary antibodies: anti-Brn3a, anti-Brn3b, and anti-CD31 diluted in blocking buffer.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 72 hours)
2.3 Washing with PBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100 for three times.(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
2.4 Incubation with secondary antibodies: Alexa Fluor 488, Alexa Fluor 568, and Alexa Fluor 647 diluted in blocking buffer.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
2.5 Final washing in PBS for three times.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

3 **Dehydration and Optical Clearing**
3.1 Dehydration in a graded ethanol series: 50%, 70%, and 100% (vol/vol) ethanol in distilled water.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per step)
3.2 Final dehydration in 100% (vol/vol) anhydrous ethanol to ensure complete removal of water.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.3 Refractive index matching by incubating the sample in 100% Ethyl Cinnamate (ECi) until the retina becomes transparent.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

payload.protocol:
**Chosen Labeling:** [Brn3a+Alexa Fluor 488, Brn3b+Alexa Fluor 568, CD31+Alexa Fluor 647], EyeCi
**Chosen Method:** EyeCi
**Justification:** EyeCi is specifically optimized for the ocular structure, which contains high levels of melanin that cause significant light absorption and scattering. The protocol includes a hydrogen peroxide bleaching step in an organic solvent environment, which effectively removes intraocular pigment while preserving the structural integrity of the retina. By removing the cornea and lens, the reagents can better penetrate the Retinal Ganglion Cell (RGC) layer. The use of Alexa Fluor dyes combined with the high refractive index matching of Ethyl Cinnamate (ECi) ensures high-contrast imaging of both the delicate retinal vasculature (CD31) and the nuclear transcription factors (Brn3a/Brn3b) with minimal background interference.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 **Pre-treatment and Pigment Bleaching**
1.1 Dissection of the fixed eyeball in PBS to remove the cornea and lens to facilitate reagent penetration.(Temperature: RT, Time: 0.5 hours)
1.2 Dehydration in a graded ethanol series: 50%, 70%, and 100% (vol/vol) ethanol in distilled water.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per step)
1.3 Incubation in bleaching solution containing 3% H2O2 (vol/vol) in 100% ethanol to remove melanin.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 18 hours)
1.4 Rehydration in a graded ethanol series: 100%, 70%, and 50% (vol/vol) ethanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per step)

2 **Immunolabeling**
2.1 Permeabilization and blocking in PBS containing 0.5% Triton X-100 and 5% Normal Donkey Serum.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
2.2 Incubation with primary antibodies: anti-Brn3a, anti-Brn3b, and anti-CD31 diluted in blocking buffer.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 72 hours)
2.3 Washing with PBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100 for three times.(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
2.4 Incubation with secondary antibodies: Alexa Fluor 488, Alexa Fluor 568, and Alexa Fluor 647 diluted in blocking buffer.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
2.5 Final washing in PBS for three times.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

3 **Dehydration and Optical Clearing**
3.1 Dehydration in a graded ethanol series: 50%, 70%, and 100% (vol/vol) ethanol in distilled water.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per step)
3.2 Final dehydration in 100% (vol/vol) anhydrous ethanol to ensure complete removal of water.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.3 Refractive index matching by incubating the sample in 100% Ethyl Cinnamate (ECi) until the retina becomes transparent.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
3.4 Storage and imaging of the cleared eyeball in fresh Ethyl Cinnamate (ECi) using a light-sheet or confocal microscope.(Temperature: RT, Time: Indefinite)

**Chosen Labeling:** [B220 (PTPRC) + Alexa Fluor 594, Lectin + Alexa Fluor 488, DAPI]
**Justification:** CUBIC is selected for its superior decolorization capability, which is essential for the heme-rich spleen to achieve high transparency. It removes light-absorbing heme using aminoalcohols (CUBIC-L) while preserving protein antigenicity for immunolabeling. B220 (PTPRC) identifies the pan-B cell population, while Lectin (specifically targeting activated B cells/GCs) serves as the auxiliary channel for germinal center identification. DAPI provides the cellular context and density information required to compare follicular heterogeneity and inter-follicular spaces.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Delipidation and Decolorization
1.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) CUBIC-L (diluted with distilled water) for 24 hours with gentle shaking.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
1.2 Incubation with 100% CUBIC-L (10 wt% Triton X-100, 10 wt% N-butyldiethanolamine) for 4 days with gentle shaking, replacing the reagent every 2 days until the spleen becomes white/pale.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 96 hours)

2 Washing and Blocking
2.1 Washing with PBS for 6 hours with gentle shaking, replacing the buffer every 2 hours to remove residual aminoalcohols.(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
2.2 Incubation with blocking buffer (PBS containing 5% BSA and 0.5% Triton X-100) for 12 hours with gentle shaking.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

3 Immunostaining and Labeling
3.1 Incubation with B220 (PTPRC) antibody conjugated to Alexa Fluor 594 (1:100), Lectin conjugated to Alexa Fluor 488 (1:100), and DAPI (1:500) in blocking buffer for 5 days with gentle shaking to ensure deep penetration into the 5 mm thick tissue.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 120 hours)
3.2 Washing with PBS containing 0.5% Triton X-100 for 12 hours with gentle shaking, replacing the buffer every 3 hours.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

4 Refractive Index Matching
4.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) CUBIC-R (diluted with distilled water) for 24 hours with gentle shaking.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

payload.protocol:
**Chosen Method:** CUBIC
**Chosen Labeling:** [B220 (PTPRC) + Alexa Fluor 594, Lectin + Alexa Fluor 488, DAPI]
**Justification:** CUBIC is selected for its superior decolorization capability, which is essential for the heme-rich spleen to achieve high transparency. It removes light-absorbing heme using aminoalcohols (CUBIC-L) while preserving protein antigenicity for immunolabeling. B220 (PTPRC) identifies the pan-B cell population, while Lectin (specifically targeting activated B cells/GCs) serves as the auxiliary channel for germinal center identification. DAPI provides the cellular context and density information required to compare follicular heterogeneity and inter-follicular spaces.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Delipidation and Decolorization
1.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) CUBIC-L (diluted with distilled water) for 24 hours with gentle shaking.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
1.2 Incubation with 100% CUBIC-L (10 wt% Triton X-100, 10 wt% N-butyldiethanolamine) for 4 days with gentle shaking, replacing the reagent every 2 days until the spleen becomes white/pale.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 96 hours)

2 Washing and Blocking
2.1 Washing with PBS for 6 hours with gentle shaking, replacing the buffer every 2 hours to remove residual aminoalcohols.(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
2.2 Incubation with blocking buffer (PBS containing 5% BSA and 0.5% Triton X-100) for 12 hours with gentle shaking.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

3 Immunostaining and Labeling
3.1 Incubation with B220 (PTPRC) antibody conjugated to Alexa Fluor 594 (1:100), Lectin conjugated to Alexa Fluor 488 (1:100), and DAPI (1:500) in blocking buffer for 5 days with gentle shaking to ensure deep penetration into the 5 mm thick tissue.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 120 hours)
3.2 Washing with PBS containing 0.5% Triton X-100 for 12 hours with gentle shaking, replacing the buffer every 3 hours.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

4 Refractive Index Matching
4.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) CUBIC-R (diluted with distilled water) for 24 hours with gentle shaking.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
4.2 Incubation with 100% CUBIC-R (45 wt% antipyrine, 30 wt% nicotinamide, RI ≈ 1.52) for 24 hours with gentle shaking until the tissue reaches maximum transparency.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

**Chosen Labeling:** [C-FoS+Alexa Fluor 647, NeuN (RBFOX3)+Alexa Fluor 568, DAPI]
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is the gold standard for whole-mount immunolabeling and clearing of large, intact tissues like the mouse brain and tongue. Its methanol-based dehydration and organic solvent delipidation (DCM) facilitate deep antibody penetration, which is essential for labeling activity-dependent markers like C-FoS in deep brain structures (e.g., LC, PVT). NeuN provides a comprehensive neuronal anatomical framework, while DAPI serves as a nuclear reference for registration. This method effectively clears both the lipid-rich brain and the dense muscular tissue of the tongue, preserving the spatial continuity of the tongue-brain circuit.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Sample Pretreatment (Dehydration & Bleaching)
1.1 Incubation with a methanol gradient (20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, 100% vol/vol in H2O) for dehydration. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)
1.2 Incubation with chilled 5% H2O2 in methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 5 volumes MeOH) to reduce autofluorescence. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
1.3 Incubation with a reverse methanol gradient (80%, 60%, 40%, 20% vol/vol in H2O) for rehydration. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)

2 Whole-mount Immunolabeling
2.1 Incubation with PTx2 solution (PBS with 0.2% Triton X-100). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
2.2 Incubation with Permeabilization Solution (PBS with 0.2% Triton X-100, 20% DMSO, and 0.3 M glycine). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
2.3 Incubation with Blocking Solution (PBS with 0.2% Triton X-100, 10% DMSO, and 6% donkey serum). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
2.4 Incubation with Primary Antibodies (C-FoS and NeuN (RBFOX3) diluted 1:500 in PTwH with 5% DMSO and 3% donkey serum). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 6 days)
2.5 Incubation with PTwH (PBS with 0.2% Tween-20 and 10 μg/ml Heparin) for washing. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
2.6 Incubation with Secondary Antibodies (Alexa Fluor 647 and Alexa Fluor 568) and DAPI (1:1000) in PTwH with 3% donkey serum. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 6 days)
2.7 Incubation with PTwH for washing. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

3 Tissue Clearing and RI Matching
3.1 Incubation with a methanol gradient (20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, 100%, 100% vol/vol in H2O) for final dehydration. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)
3.2 Incubation with 66% dichloromethane (DCM) / 33% methanol for delipidation. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
3.3 Incubation with 100% dichloromethane (DCM) to remove residual methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)
3.4 Incubation with 100% Dibenzyl ether (DBE) for refractive index matching and final clearing. payload.protocol:
**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [C-FoS+Alexa Fluor 647, NeuN (RBFOX3)+Alexa Fluor 568, DAPI]
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is the gold standard for whole-mount immunolabeling and clearing of large, intact tissues like the mouse brain and tongue. Its methanol-based dehydration and organic solvent delipidation (DCM) facilitate deep antibody penetration, which is essential for labeling activity-dependent markers like C-FoS in deep brain structures (e.g., LC, PVT). NeuN provides a comprehensive neuronal anatomical framework, while DAPI serves as a nuclear reference for registration. This method effectively clears both the lipid-rich brain and the dense muscular tissue of the tongue, preserving the spatial continuity of the tongue-brain circuit.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Sample Pretreatment (Dehydration & Bleaching)
1.1 Incubation with a methanol gradient (20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, 100% vol/vol in H2O) for dehydration. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)
1.2 Incubation with chilled 5% H2O2 in methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 5 volumes MeOH) to reduce autofluorescence. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
1.3 Incubation with a reverse methanol gradient (80%, 60%, 40%, 20% vol/vol in H2O) for rehydration. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)

2 Whole-mount Immunolabeling
2.1 Incubation with PTx2 solution (PBS with 0.2% Triton X-100). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
2.2 Incubation with Permeabilization Solution (PBS with 0.2% Triton X-100, 20% DMSO, and 0.3 M glycine). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
2.3 Incubation with Blocking Solution (PBS with 0.2% Triton X-100, 10% DMSO, and 6% donkey serum). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
2.4 Incubation with Primary Antibodies (C-FoS and NeuN (RBFOX3) diluted 1:500 in PTwH with 5% DMSO and 3% donkey serum). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 6 days)
2.5 Incubation with PTwH (PBS with 0.2% Tween-20 and 10 μg/ml Heparin) for washing. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
2.6 Incubation with Secondary Antibodies (Alexa Fluor 647 and Alexa Fluor 568) and DAPI (1:1000) in PTwH with 3% donkey serum. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 6 days)
2.7 Incubation with PTwH for washing. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

3 Tissue Clearing and RI Matching
3.1 Incubation with a methanol gradient (20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, 100%, 100% vol/vol in H2O) for final dehydration. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)
3.2 Incubation with 66% dichloromethane (DCM) / 33% methanol for delipidation. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
3.3 Incubation with 100% dichloromethane (DCM) to remove residual methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)
3.4 Incubation with 100% Dibenzyl ether (DBE) for refractive index matching and final clearing. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours or until transparent)

{"version":"candidate-only-subobligation-support-consumer-v2-exact-member-aliases","schema_version":"full-criterion-subobligation-schema-v1","protocol":"**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [Insulin, Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is the most effective method for whole-mount immunolabeling and clearing of dense organs like the pancreas. The methanol-based pretreatment and organic solvent clearing (DBE) ensure high transparency and deep antibody penetration, which is essential for identifying all islets in a 3 mm thick tissue. Insulin is the definitive marker for β cells, and Alexa Fluor 647 is chosen for its high photostability and low tissue autofluorescence in the far-red spectrum. DAPI provides a nuclear counterstain to visualize the overall islet structure and tissue density.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Pretreatment and Permeabilization
1.1 Incubation with a methanol gradient (20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, 100%, and 100% vol/vol) for 1 hour each.(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
1.2 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H2O2 in methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 5 volumes MeOH).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
1.3 Incubation with a reverse methanol gradient (80%, 60%, 40%, 20% vol/vol, and PBS) for 1 hour each.(Temperature: RT, Time: 5 hours)
1.4 Incubation with permeabilization solution (PBS/0.2% Triton X-100/20% DMSO/0.3 M glycine).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
1.5 Incubation with blocking solution (PBS/0.2% Triton X-100/10% DMSO/6% Donkey Serum).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

2 Whole-mount Immunolabeling
2.1 Incubation with primary antibody (Anti-Insulin, 1:200) in PTwH (PBS/0.2% Tween-20 with 10 µg/ml Heparin) containing 5% DMSO and 3% Donkey Serum.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 96 hours)
2.2 Washing with PTwH for 5 times.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
2.3 Incubation with secondary antibody (Alexa Fluor 647, 1:500) and DAPI (1:1000) in PTwH containing 3% Donkey Serum.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 96 hours)
2.4 Washing with PTwH for 5 times.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

3 Dehydration and RI Matching
3.1 Incubation with a methanol gradient (20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, 100%, and 100% vol/vol) for 1 hour each.(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
3.2 Incubation with a mixture of dichloromethane (DCM) and methanol (2:1 vol/vol).(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
3.3 Incubation with 100% DCM to remove remaining methanol and lipids.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)
3.4 Incubation with 100% Dibenzyl ether (DBE) for refractive index matching until the tissue becomes completely transparent.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

payload.protocol:
**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [Insulin, Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is the most effective method for whole-mount immunolabeling and clearing of dense organs like the pancreas. The methanol-based pretreatment and organic solvent clearing (DBE) ensure high transparency and deep antibody penetration, which is essential for identifying all islets in a 3 mm thick tissue. Insulin is the definitive marker for β cells, and Alexa Fluor 647 is chosen for its high photostability and low tissue autofluorescence in the far-red spectrum. DAPI provides a nuclear counterstain to visualize the overall islet structure and tissue density.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Pretreatment and Permeabilization
1.1 Incubation with a methanol gradient (20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, 100%, and 100% vol/vol) for 1 hour each.(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
1.2 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H2O2 in methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 5 volumes MeOH).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
1.3 Incubation with a reverse methanol gradient (80%, 60%, 40%, 20% vol/vol, and PBS) for 1 hour each.(Temperature: RT, Time: 5 hours)
1.4 Incubation with permeabilization solution (PBS/0.2% Triton X-100/20% DMSO/0.3 M glycine).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
1.5 Incubation with blocking solution (PBS/0.2% Triton X-100/10% DMSO/6% Donkey Serum).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

2 Whole-mount Immunolabeling
2.1 Incubation with primary antibody (Anti-Insulin, 1:200) in PTwH (PBS/0.2% Tween-20 with 10 µg/ml Heparin) containing 5% DMSO and 3% Donkey Serum.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 96 hours)
2.2 Washing with PTwH for 5 times.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
2.3 Incubation with secondary antibody (Alexa Fluor 647, 1:500) and DAPI (1:1000) in PTwH containing 3% Donkey Serum.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 96 hours)
2.4 Washing with PTwH for 5 times.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

3 Dehydration and RI Matching
3.1 Incubation with a methanol gradient (20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, 100%, and 100% vol/vol) for 1 hour each.(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
3.2 Incubation with a mixture of dichloromethane (DCM) and methanol (2:1 vol/vol).(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
3.3 Incubation with 100% DCM to remove remaining methanol and lipids.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)
3.4 Incubation with 100% Dibenzyl ether (DBE) for refractive index matching until the tissue becomes completely transparent.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
3.5 Storage in fresh 100% DBE in a dark, airtight glass vial prior to light-sheet imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: Indefinite)

{"version":"candidate-only-subobligation-support-consumer-v4-published-instance-criteria","schema_version":"full-criterion-subobligation-schema-v2-published-instance-parameters","protocol":"**Chosen Method:** EyeCi; **Chosen Labeling:** [HuC/D, NeuN (RBFOX3), Alexa Fluor, DAPI]

**Justification:** EyeCi is specifically optimized for the unique challenges of the whole mouse eye, which contains a highly opaque pigment layer (RPE) and a dense, high-refractive-index lens. This method utilizes H2O2-based bleaching to clear the melanin without significantly quenching fluorescence, followed by refractive index (RI) matching with Ethyl Cinnamate (ECi, RI ≈ 1.56), which is exceptionally effective for the ocular lens and retina. For labeling, HuC/D is a robust cytoplasmic marker for retinal ganglion cells (RGCs), while NeuN (RBFOX3) serves as a nuclear marker (representing the transcription factor-related signal in this context). This dual-labeling strategy allows for 3D cross-validation of cell identity, enabling precise cell counting and spatial distribution analysis while minimizing false positives/negatives.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Bleaching and Permeabilization
1.1 Incubation with bleaching solution (3% H2O2 and 0.5% Triton X-100 in PBS) to remove melanin from the RPE.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
1.2 Incubation with permeabilization buffer (0.5% Triton X-100, 10% DMSO, and 0.1M Glycine in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

2 Immunostaining (Pre-imaging treatment)
2.1 Incubation with blocking buffer (5% Normal Donkey Serum, 0.5% Triton X-100, and 10% DMSO in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
2.2 Incubation with primary antibodies: HuC/D (1:200) and NeuN (RBFOX3) (1:200) in blocking buffer.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 120 hours)
2.3 Wash with washing buffer (0.2% Tween-20 and 10 μg/ml Heparin in PBS).(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
2.4 Incubation with secondary antibodies: Alexa Fluor 488 and Alexa Fluor 594 (1:500) and DAPI (1:1000) in blocking buffer.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)
2.5 Wash with washing buffer (0.2% Tween-20 and 10 μg/ml Heparin in PBS).(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

3 Dehydration
3.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) ethanol aqueous solution.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 2 hours)
3.2 Incubation with 70% (vol/vol) ethanol aqueous solution.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 2 hours)
3.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) ethanol.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 2 hours)
3.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) ethanol.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

4 RI Matching and Clearing
4.1 Incubation with 99% Ethyl Cinnamate (ECi) for refractive index matching and final clearing.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)

payload.protocol:
**Chosen Method:** EyeCi; **Chosen Labeling:** [HuC/D, NeuN (RBFOX3), Alexa Fluor, DAPI]

**Justification:** EyeCi is specifically optimized for the unique challenges of the whole mouse eye, which contains a highly opaque pigment layer (RPE) and a dense, high-refractive-index lens. This method utilizes H2O2-based bleaching to clear the melanin without significantly quenching fluorescence, followed by refractive index (RI) matching with Ethyl Cinnamate (ECi, RI ≈ 1.56), which is exceptionally effective for the ocular lens and retina. For labeling, HuC/D is a robust cytoplasmic marker for retinal ganglion cells (RGCs), while NeuN (RBFOX3) serves as a nuclear marker (representing the transcription factor-related signal in this context). This dual-labeling strategy allows for 3D cross-validation of cell identity, enabling precise cell counting and spatial distribution analysis while minimizing false positives/negatives.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Bleaching and Permeabilization
1.1 Incubation with bleaching solution (3% H2O2 and 0.5% Triton X-100 in PBS) to remove melanin from the RPE.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
1.2 Incubation with permeabilization buffer (0.5% Triton X-100, 10% DMSO, and 0.1M Glycine in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

2 Immunostaining (Pre-imaging treatment)
2.1 Incubation with blocking buffer (5% Normal Donkey Serum, 0.5% Triton X-100, and 10% DMSO in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
2.2 Incubation with primary antibodies: HuC/D (1:200) and NeuN (RBFOX3) (1:200) in blocking buffer.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 120 hours)
2.3 Wash with washing buffer (0.2% Tween-20 and 10 μg/ml Heparin in PBS).(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
2.4 Incubation with secondary antibodies: Alexa Fluor 488 and Alexa Fluor 594 (1:500) and DAPI (1:1000) in blocking buffer.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)
2.5 Wash with washing buffer (0.2% Tween-20 and 10 μg/ml Heparin in PBS).(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

3 Dehydration
3.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) ethanol aqueous solution.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 2 hours)
3.2 Incubation with 70% (vol/vol) ethanol aqueous solution.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 2 hours)
3.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) ethanol.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 2 hours)
3.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) ethanol.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

4 RI Matching and Clearing
4.1 Incubation with 99% Ethyl Cinnamate (ECi) for refractive index matching and final clearing.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)

candidate_catalog.quote: **Chosen Method:** EyeCi; **Chosen Labeling:** [HuC/D, NeuN (RBFOX3), Alexa Fluor, DAPI]

**Justification:** EyeCi is specifically optimized for the unique challenges of the whole mouse eye, which contains a highly opaque pigment layer (RPE) and a dense, high-refractive-index lens. This method utilizes H2O2-based bleaching to clear the melanin without significantly quenching fluorescence, followed by refractive index (RI) matching with Ethyl Cinnamate (ECi, RI ≈ 1.56), which is exceptionally effective for the ocular lens and retina. For labeling, HuC/D is a robust cytoplasmic marker for retinal ganglion cells (RGCs), while NeuN (RBFOX3) serves as a nuclear marker (representing the transcription factor-related signal in this context). This dual-labeling strategy allows for 3D cross-validation of cell identity, enabling precise cell counting and spatial distribution analysis while minimizing false positives/negatives.
**Protocol Steps:**
1 Bleaching and Permeabilization
1.1 Incubation with bleaching solution (3% H2O2 and 0.5% Triton X-100 in PBS) to remove melanin from the RPE.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
1.2 Incubation with permeabilization buffer (0.5% Triton X-100, 10% DMSO, and 0.1M Glycine in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
2 Immunostaining (Pre-imaging treatment)
2.1 Incubation with blocking buffer (5% Normal Donkey Serum, 0.5% Triton X-100, and 10% DMSO in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
2.2 Incubation with primary antibodies: HuC/D (1:200) and NeuN (RBFOX3) (1:200) in blocking buffer.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 120 hours)
2.3 Wash with washing buffer (0.2% Tween-20 and 10 μg/ml Heparin in PBS).(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
2.4 Incubation with secondary antibodies: Alexa Fluor 488 and Alexa Fluor 594 (1:500) and DAPI (1:1000) in blocking buffer.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)
2.5 Wash with washing buffer (0.2% Tween-20 and 10 μg/ml Heparin in PBS).(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
3 Dehydration
3.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) ethanol aqueous solution.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 2 hours)
3.2 Incubation with 70% (vol/vol) ethanol aqueous solution.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 2 hours)
3.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) ethanol.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 2 hours)
3.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) ethanol.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
4 RI Matching and Clearing
4.1 Incubation with 99% Ethyl Cinnamate (ECi) for refractive index matching and final clearing.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
4.2 Storage in fresh 99% Ethyl Cinnamate (ECi) in a dark, airtight container prior to light-sheet or confocal imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

{"version":"candidate-only-subobligation-support-consumer-v2-exact-member-aliases","schema_version":"full-criterion-subobligation-schema-v1","protocol":"**所选荧光/标记策略与透明方法（第1行）：** 功能性灌流通道=Lectin（体内灌流，Alexa Fluor 647 偶联）；结构性内皮通道=CD31(PECAM1)+Alexa Fluor 568（二抗）；核染=TO-PRO-3；透明方法=iDISCO+（含脱色/漂白与DBE RI匹配）  
**Justification:** 黑色素瘤黑色素高、深部散射/吸收强，iDISCO+ 的有机溶剂脱水+去脂+高RI匹配对 8–10 mm 实体肿瘤穿透与透明效果更稳定；甲醇/过氧化氢漂白可显著降低黑色素与血红素相关背景。Lectin 体内灌流优先回答“真实灌流腔面”功能问题；CD31 免疫标记提供“内皮结构网络”，两通道可在三维中比较重叠/断裂/缺失与灌流不均一。远红/近红（AF647、TO-PRO-3）在残余色素背景下信噪比更优，且与iDISCO+兼容。

**Protocol Steps:**

1.3 漂白：5% H2O2 in MeOH（由30% H2O2:MeOH=1:5 配制），避光轻摇。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12–18 h)  
1.4 100% MeOH 洗去 H2O2。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2×30 min)  
1.5 逐级复水：80%/60%/40%/20% MeOH in dH2O → PBS。(Temperature: RT, Time: each 30 min)

2 渗透与封闭（为整块肿瘤免疫染色做准备）
2.1 渗透：PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100（PTx），轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 h)  
2.2 渗透增强：PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 20% DMSO + 0.3 M Glycine，轻摇。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12–16 h)  
2.3 封闭：PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 10% DMSO + 6% Normal Donkey Serum（或与二抗宿主匹配血清），轻摇。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12–16 h)

3.4 洗涤：PTwH。(Temperature: RT, Time: 6×1 h + 1×overnight)

4 核染（用于肿瘤核心/边缘分区与配准）
4.1 TO-PRO-3 核染：TO-PRO-3 1:1000（或约 1–2 µM）溶于 PTwH，避光轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 6–12 h)  
4.2 PTwH 洗涤去游离染料。(Temperature: RT, Time: 3×1 h)

5.1 逐级甲醇脱水：20%/40%/60%/80%/100% MeOH，轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: each 1 h；100% 再 1 h)  
5.2 二氯甲烷（DCM）去脂：66% DCM/33% MeOH（vol/vol），轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 h)  
5.3 100% DCM 去脂/置换，轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2×15–30 min)

6 RI 匹配（透明化完成）
6.1 DBE（Dibenzyl ether，RI≈1.56）预匹配：新鲜 DBE 全浸没，避光。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2–3 h)

payload.protocol:
**所选荧光/标记策略与透明方法（第1行）：** 功能性灌流通道=Lectin（体内灌流，Alexa Fluor 647 偶联）；结构性内皮通道=CD31(PECAM1)+Alexa Fluor 568（二抗）；核染=TO-PRO-3；透明方法=iDISCO+（含脱色/漂白与DBE RI匹配）  
**Justification:** 黑色素瘤黑色素高、深部散射/吸收强，iDISCO+ 的有机溶剂脱水+去脂+高RI匹配对 8–10 mm 实体肿瘤穿透与透明效果更稳定；甲醇/过氧化氢漂白可显著降低黑色素与血红素相关背景。Lectin 体内灌流优先回答“真实灌流腔面”功能问题；CD31 免疫标记提供“内皮结构网络”，两通道可在三维中比较重叠/断裂/缺失与灌流不均一。远红/近红（AF647、TO-PRO-3）在残余色素背景下信噪比更优，且与iDISCO+兼容。

**Protocol Steps:**

1 样本预处理与漂白（降低黑色素/血红素背景）
1.1 PBS 清洗（pH 7.4）去除固定液残留，轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 3×30 min)  
1.2 逐级甲醇脱水：20%/40%/60%/80%/100% MeOH in dH2O，轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: each 1 h；100% 再 1 h)  
1.3 漂白：5% H2O2 in MeOH（由30% H2O2:MeOH=1:5 配制），避光轻摇。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12–18 h)  
1.4 100% MeOH 洗去 H2O2。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2×30 min)  
1.5 逐级复水：80%/60%/40%/20% MeOH in dH2O → PBS。(Temperature: RT, Time: each 30 min)

2 渗透与封闭（为整块肿瘤免疫染色做准备）
2.1 渗透：PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100（PTx），轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 h)  
2.2 渗透增强：PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 20% DMSO + 0.3 M Glycine，轻摇。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12–16 h)  
2.3 封闭：PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 10% DMSO + 6% Normal Donkey Serum（或与二抗宿主匹配血清），轻摇。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12–16 h)

3 结构性血管内皮免疫标记（CD31）
3.1 一抗孵育：抗 CD31(PECAM1)（建议 1:200，溶于 PBS + 0.2% Tween-20 + 10 µg/mL Heparin + 5% DMSO + 3% NDS），全浸没、避光轻摇。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 3–5 days；8–10 mm 肿瘤建议 5 days)  
3.2 洗涤：PBS + 0.2% Tween-20 + 10 µg/mL Heparin（PTwH），充分换液。(Temperature: RT, Time: 6×1 h + 1×overnight)  
3.3 二抗孵育：Donkey anti-rat（或匹配一抗宿主）Alexa Fluor 568（建议 1:400，溶于 PTwH + 3% NDS），避光轻摇。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 2–3 days)  
3.4 洗涤：PTwH。(Temperature: RT, Time: 6×1 h + 1×overnight)

4 核染（用于肿瘤核心/边缘分区与配准）
4.1 TO-PRO-3 核染：TO-PRO-3 1:1000（或约 1–2 µM）溶于 PTwH，避光轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 6–12 h)  
4.2 PTwH 洗涤去游离染料。(Temperature: RT, Time: 3×1 h)

5 iDISCO+ 去脂/脱水（为有机RI匹配做准备）
5.1 逐级甲醇脱水：20%/40%/60%/80%/100% MeOH，轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: each 1 h；100% 再 1 h)  
5.2 二氯甲烷（DCM）去脂：66% DCM/33% MeOH（vol/vol），轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 h)  
5.3 100% DCM 去脂/置换，轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2×15–30 min)

6 RI 匹配（透明化完成）

**Justification:** 黑色素瘤黑色素高、深部散射/吸收强，iDISCO+ 的有机溶剂脱水+去脂+高RI匹配对 8–10 mm 实体肿瘤穿透与透明效果更稳定；甲醇/过氧化氢漂白可显著降低黑色素与血红素相关背景。Lectin 体内灌流优先回答“真实灌流腔面”功能问题；CD31 免疫标记提供“内皮结构网络”，两通道可在三维中比较重叠/断裂/缺失与灌流不均一。远红/近红（AF647、TO-PRO-3）在残余色素背景下信噪比更优，且与iDISCO+兼容。

1 样本预处理与漂白（降低黑色素/血红素背景）

1.5 逐级复水：80%/60%/40%/20% MeOH in dH2O → PBS。(Temperature: RT, Time: each 30 min)

2.2 渗透增强：PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 20% DMSO + 0.3 M Glycine，轻摇。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12–16 h)

4.1 TO-PRO-3 核染：TO-PRO-3 1:1000（或约 1–2 µM）溶于 PTwH，避光轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 6–12 h)
4.2 PTwH 洗涤去游离染料。(Temperature: RT, Time: 3×1 h)

{"version":"candidate-only-subobligation-support-consumer-v2-exact-member-aliases","schema_version":"full-criterion-subobligation-schema-v1","protocol":"**所选荧光/标记策略与透明方法（第1行）：** 功能性灌流通道=Lectin（体内灌流，Alexa Fluor 647 偶联）；结构性内皮通道=CD31(PECAM1)+Alexa Fluor 568（二抗）；核染=TO-PRO-3；透明方法=iDISCO+（含脱色/漂白与DBE RI匹配）  
**Justification:** 黑色素瘤黑色素高、深部散射/吸收强，iDISCO+ 的有机溶剂脱水+去脂+高RI匹配对 8–10 mm 实体肿瘤穿透与透明效果更稳定；甲醇/过氧化氢漂白可显著降低黑色素与血红素相关背景。Lectin 体内灌流优先回答“真实灌流腔面”功能问题；CD31 免疫标记提供“内皮结构网络”，两通道可在三维中比较重叠/断裂/缺失与灌流不均一。远红/近红（AF647、TO-PRO-3）在残余色素背景下信噪比更优，且与iDISCO+兼容。

**Protocol Steps:**

1 样本预处理与漂白（降低黑色素/血红素背景）
1.1 PBS 清洗（pH 7.4）去除固定液残留，轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 3×30 min)  
1.2 逐级甲醇脱水：20%/40%/60%/80%/100% MeOH in dH2O，轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: each 1 h；100% 再 1 h)  
1.3 漂白：5% H2O2 in MeOH（由30% H2O2:MeOH=1:5 配制），避光轻摇。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12–18 h)  
1.4 100% MeOH 洗去 H2O2。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2×30 min)  
1.5 逐级复水：80%/60%/40%/20% MeOH in dH2O → PBS。(Temperature: RT, Time: each 30 min)

2 渗透与封闭（为整块肿瘤免疫染色做准备）
2.1 渗透：PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100（PTx），轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 h)  
2.2 渗透增强：PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 20% DMSO + 0.3 M Glycine，轻摇。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12–16 h)  
2.3 封闭：PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 10% DMSO + 6% Normal Donkey Serum（或与二抗宿主匹配血清），轻摇。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12–16 h)

3 结构性血管内皮免疫标记（CD31）
3.1 一抗孵育：抗 CD31(PECAM1)（建议 1:200，溶于 PBS + 0.2% Tween-20 + 10 µg/mL Heparin + 5% DMSO + 3% NDS），全浸没、避光轻摇。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 3–5 days；8–10 mm 肿瘤建议 5 days)  
3.2 洗涤：PBS + 0.2% Tween-20 + 10 µg/mL Heparin（PTwH），充分换液。(Temperature: RT, Time: 6×1 h + 1×overnight)  
3.3 二抗孵育：Donkey anti-rat（或匹配一抗宿主）Alexa Fluor 568（建议 1:400，溶于 PTwH + 3% NDS），避光轻摇。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 2–3 days)  
3.4 洗涤：PTwH。(Temperature: RT, Time: 6×1 h + 1×overnight)

4 核染（用于肿瘤核心/边缘分区与配准）
4.1 TO-PRO-3 核染：TO-PRO-3 1:1000（或约 1–2 µM）溶于 PTwH，避光轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 6–12 h)  
4.2 PTwH 洗涤去游离染料。(Temperature: RT, Time: 3×1 h)

5 iDISCO+ 去脂/脱水（为有机RI匹配做准备）
5.1 逐级甲醇脱水：20%/40%/60%/80%/100% MeOH，轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: each 1 h；100% 再 1 h)  
5.2 二氯甲烷（DCM）去脂：66% DCM/33% MeOH（vol/vol），轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 h)  
5.3 100% DCM 去脂/置换，轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2×15–30 min)

6 RI 匹配（透明化完成）
6.1 DBE（Dibenzyl ether，RI≈1.56）预匹配：新鲜 DBE 全浸没，避光。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2–3 h)  
6.2 DBE 终匹配：更换新鲜 DBE，直至组织完全透明、无明显折射梯度。(Temperature: RT, Time: 12–24 h；必要时延长至 48 h)

7 保存与成像前处理（保持信号与减少背景）
7.1 DBE 中避光保存：密封玻璃瓶（DBE 可溶胀部分塑料），尽量充满减少氧化。(Temperature: RT 或 4 ℃, Time: up to 1–2 weeks)  
7.2 成像前脱气/去气泡：样本在新鲜 DBE 中静置或真空短暂脱气以减少光片条纹与气泡。(Temperature: RT, Time: 15–30 min)

**所选荧光/标记策略与透明方法（第1行）：** 功能性灌流通道=Lectin（体内灌流，Alexa Fluor 647 偶联）；结构性内皮通道=CD31(PECAM1)+Alexa Fluor 568（二抗）；核染=TO-PRO-3；透明方法=iDISCO+（含脱色/漂白与DBE RI匹配）  
**Justification:** 黑色素瘤黑色素高、深部散射/吸收强，iDISCO+ 的有机溶剂脱水+去脂+高RI匹配对 8–10 mm 实体肿瘤穿透与透明效果更稳定；甲醇/过氧化氢漂白可显著降低黑色素与血红素相关背景。Lectin 体内灌流优先回答“真实灌流腔面”功能问题；CD31 免疫标记提供“内皮结构网络”，两通道可在三维中比较重叠/断裂/缺失与灌流不均一。远红/近红（AF647、TO-PRO-3）在残余色素背景下信噪比更优，且与iDISCO+兼容。

**Protocol Steps:**

1 样本预处理与漂白（降低黑色素/血红素背景）
1.1 PBS 清洗（pH 7.4）去除固定液残留，轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 3×30 min)  
1.2 逐级甲醇脱水：20%/40%/60%/80%/100% MeOH in dH2O，轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: each 1 h；100% 再 1 h)  
1.3 漂白：5% H2O2 in MeOH（由30% H2O2:MeOH=1:5 配制），避光轻摇。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12–18 h)  
1.4 100% MeOH 洗去 H2O2。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2×30 min)  
1.5 逐级复水：80%/60%/40%/20% MeOH in dH2O → PBS。(Temperature: RT, Time: each 30 min)

2 渗透与封闭（为整块肿瘤免疫染色做准备）
2.1 渗透：PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100（PTx），轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 h)  
2.2 渗透增强：PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 20% DMSO + 0.3 M Glycine，轻摇。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12–16 h)  
2.3 封闭：PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 10% DMSO + 6% Normal Donkey Serum（或与二抗宿主匹配血清），轻摇。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12–16 h)

3 结构性血管内皮免疫标记（CD31）
3.1 一抗孵育：抗 CD31(PECAM1)（建议 1:200，溶于 PBS + 0.2% Tween-20 + 10 µg/mL Heparin + 5% DMSO + 3% NDS），全浸没、避光轻摇。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 3–5 days；8–10 mm 肿瘤建议 5 days)  
3.2 洗涤：PBS + 0.2% Tween-20 + 10 µg/mL Heparin（PTwH），充分换液。(Temperature: RT, Time: 6×1 h + 1×overnight)  
3.3 二抗孵育：Donkey anti-rat（或匹配一抗宿主）Alexa Fluor 568（建议 1:400，溶于 PTwH + 3% NDS），避光轻摇。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 2–3 days)  
3.4 洗涤：PTwH。(Temperature: RT, Time: 6×1 h + 1×overnight)

4 核染（用于肿瘤核心/边缘分区与配准）
4.1 TO-PRO-3 核染：TO-PRO-3 1:1000（或约 1–2 µM）溶于 PTwH，避光轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 6–12 h)  
4.2 PTwH 洗涤去游离染料。(Temperature: RT, Time: 3×1 h)

5 iDISCO+ 去脂/脱水（为有机RI匹配做准备）
5.1 逐级甲醇脱水：20%/40%/60%/80%/100% MeOH，轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: each 1 h；100% 再 1 h)  
5.2 二氯甲烷（DCM）去脂：66% DCM/33% MeOH（vol/vol），轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 h)  
5.3 100% DCM 去脂/置换，轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2×15–30 min)

6 RI 匹配（透明化完成）
6.1 DBE（Dibenzyl ether，RI≈1.56）预匹配：新鲜 DBE 全浸没，避光。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2–3 h)  
6.2 DBE 终匹配：更换新鲜 DBE，直至组织完全透明、无明显折射梯度。(Temperature: RT, Time: 12–24 h；必要时延长至 48 h)

7 保存与成像前处理（保持信号与减少背景）
7.1 DBE 中避光保存：密封玻璃瓶（DBE 可溶胀部分塑料），尽量充满减少氧化。(Temperature: RT 或 4 ℃, Time: up to 1–2 weeks)  
7.2 成像前脱气/去气泡：样本在新鲜 DBE 中静置或真空短暂脱气以减少光片条纹与气泡。(Temperature: RT, Time: 15–30 min)  
7.3 成像装载：使用与 DBE 兼容的样品仓与胶（如硅胶/金属夹具），全程避光；建议光片显微镜使用 561 nm（CD31-AF568）、640 nm（Lectin-AF647）、640 nm（TO-PRO-3）通道采集。(Temperature: RT, Time: 按成像时长)
